[[Zumo the Beggar|Zumo]] is a beggar that walks the streets of Wajjun Bazaar, telling the most bizarre stories to earn some [[gold]].

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Wajjun Bazaar}} (does not always [[spawn]])

==Dialogue==
:''"[[Cantha]] will make it through any difficulty so long as the [[Kisu|emperor]] is alive."''

:''"Fruit can be hard to come by these days now that the  plague has slowed trade coming from [[Kryta]]."''

:''"The docks are so empty these days. People are afraid to come to Cantha."''

:''"The emperor cares greatly for all of us who have suffered beacause of the plague."'':

:''"The guards try to keep order but there are fewer of them each day."''

:''"The local guilds are taking over the streets. Most have bought off the [[Ministry]] and do as they please."''

:''"The [[Luxon]]'' {{sic}} ''and [[Kurzick]]s have been quarreling for so long, I think they've probably forgotten why they started fighting to begin with."''

:''"The [[Celestial Ministry|Ministry of Fire]]'' ''never seems incapable of understanding the plight of the common people."''

:''"The [[Obsidian Flame (guild)|Obsidian Flame]] help keep the rogue guilds in check."''

:''"Those [[Am Fah]] thugs are frightening!"''

==Quotes==
:''"There is an old folktale in Cantha that if you give coins to a beggar he'll turn into a beautiful princess and ride off into the sunset with you. Care to try your luck?"''

:''"I need some coins to buy some ale to get rip roaring drunk, surely that's a  worthy enough cause for someone to donate? I'll let you have a few drinks with me!"''

:''"I saw a guard earlier who ordered me to inform you that you need to give me 5 gold coins to pay the passing through the market fee."''

:''"Hey, hey you! I was riding my horse to the other side of town and I ran out of hay to feed him to get there. Spare a few gold so I can feed him and be on my way?"''

:''"At least we left that old fool [[Headmaster Kaa|Kaa]] on [[Shing Jea Island]]."''

:''"For the low price of 250 gold, I, Zumo, shall single-handily remove the plague from the city of Cantha! I require only  one payment, up front, and three days to complete the task!"''

:''"Have you ever heard the story about the Emperor who went out among his people as a beggar? Well that's me! I demand you pay a tribute to your Emperor!"''

:''"One time offer, donate to the help save Zumo fund! A most remarkable cause! World renown for doing good deeds in Cantha for the last three and half minutes!"''

:''"The good [[monk]]s of Cantha have informed me  I have a horrid disease that is eating me alive. Apparently the only cure is to rub gold all over my body. Spare a few coins to save me?"''

:''"Citizens, act now, for 25 gold the Zumo flea circus will be performing on my arms! Don't miss this rare and wondrous event!"''

:''"Alms, alms for the poor!"''

:''"Life in Cantha is so terribly difficult for those down on their luck, spare a few coins to help me get out of this rut?"''

:''"Spare a few coins for a blind, mute and deaf beggar!"''
